title: [Livestream 14/11/2024] [C19T4] Locations and types of dance classes young people in a town in Australia are currently attending

frame.name: Introduction
paragraphs: The pie chart compares the variety of locations where dance classes are hosted, whereas the bar graph illustrates three types of dance styles that students from two different age groups are learning in an Australian town.

frame.name: Overview
paragraphs: Overall, private studios are the preferred choice of location among dance students. In addition, ballet classes attract the highest number of students under 11 years old, whereas modern dance classes are most popular with the older age group.

frame.name: Body 1
paragraphs: Looking first where classes are held, a significant number of students choose private studios, at 48%, making it the most popular option. The figures for the two academic facilities, which include school halls and studios located in universities, are 24% and 10% respectively. Meanwhile, 18% of dance classes are hosted in community halls and other places.

frame.name: Body 2
paragraphs: Regarding dance styles, 600 students aged under 11 engage in ballet classes, which is double the number of 11-16-year-olds. Modern dance is the least popular among the younger age group, with only 300 students choosing it, far lower than the figure for the older age group, which has 600 participants taking the class. Finally, there is a smaller disparity between the two demographics in tap dance enrollment, with 480 children under 11 and 430 children from 11 to 16 years old participating.
